blocks.source: Canto XVIII
blocks.translation: Canto XVIII

blocks.source: Luogo è in inferno detto Malebolge,
blocks.translation: There is a place in Hell called Malebolge,

blocks.source: tutto di pietra di color ferrigno,
blocks.translation: Wholly of stone and of an iron colour,

blocks.source: come la cerchia che dintorno il volge.
blocks.translation: As is the circle that around it turns.

blocks.source: Nel dritto mezzo del campo maligno
blocks.translation: Right in the middle of the field malign

blocks.source: vaneggia un pozzo assai largo e profondo,
blocks.translation: There yawns a well exceeding wide and deep,

blocks.source: di cui suo loco dicerò l’ordigno.
blocks.translation: Whose structure I shall tell in its due place.

blocks.source: Quel cinghio che rimane adunque è tondo
blocks.translation: Round, then, is that enclosure which remains

blocks.source: tra ’l pozzo e ’l piè de l’alta ripa dura,
blocks.translation: Between the well and foot of the high, hard bank,

blocks.source: e ha distinto in dieci valli il fondo.
blocks.translation: And has distinct in valleys ten its bottom.

blocks.source: Quale, dove per guardia de le mura
blocks.translation: As where for the protection of the walls

blocks.source: più e più fossi cingon li castelli,
blocks.translation: Many and many moats surround the castles,

blocks.source: la parte dove son rende figura,
blocks.translation: The part in which they are a figure forms,

blocks.source: tale imagine quivi facean quelli;
blocks.translation: Just such an image those presented there;

blocks.source: e come a tai fortezze da’ lor sogli
blocks.translation: And as about such strongholds from their gates

blocks.source: a la ripa di fuor son ponticelli,
blocks.translation: Unto the outer bank are little bridges,

blocks.source: così da imo de la roccia scogli
blocks.translation: So from the precipice’s base did crags

blocks.source: movien che ricidien li argini e ’ fossi
blocks.translation: Project, which intersected dikes and moats,

blocks.source: infino al pozzo che i tronca e raccogli.
blocks.translation: Unto the well that truncates and collects them.

blocks.source: In questo luogo, de la schiena scossi
blocks.translation: Within this place, down shaken from the back

blocks.source: di Gerïon, trovammoci; e ’l poeta
blocks.translation: Of Geryon, we found us; and the Poet

blocks.source: tenne a sinistra, e io dietro mi mossi.
blocks.translation: Held to the left, and I moved on behind.

blocks.source: A la man destra vidi nova pieta,
blocks.translation: Upon my right hand I beheld new anguish,

blocks.source: novo tormento e novi frustatori,
blocks.translation: New torments, and new wielders of the lash,

blocks.source: di che la prima bolgia era repleta.
blocks.translation: Wherewith the foremost Bolgia was replete.

blocks.source: Nel fondo erano ignudi i peccatori;
blocks.translation: Down at the bottom were the sinners naked;

blocks.source: dal mezzo in qua ci venien verso ’l volto,
blocks.translation: This side the middle came they facing us,

blocks.source: di là con noi, ma con passi maggiori,
blocks.translation: Beyond it, with us, but with greater steps;

blocks.source: come i Roman per l’essercito molto,
blocks.translation: Even as the Romans, for the mighty host,

blocks.source: l’anno del giubileo, su per lo ponte
blocks.translation: The year of Jubilee, upon the bridge,

blocks.source: hanno a passar la gente modo colto,
blocks.translation: Have chosen a mode to pass the people over;

blocks.source: che da l’un lato tutti hanno la fronte
blocks.translation: For all upon one side towards the Castle

blocks.source: verso ’l castello e vanno a Santo Pietro,
blocks.translation: Their faces have, and go unto St. Peter’s;

blocks.source: da l’altra sponda vanno verso ’l monte.
blocks.translation: On the other side they go towards the Mountain.

blocks.source: Di qua, di là, su per lo sasso tetro
blocks.translation: This side and that, along the livid stone

blocks.source: vidi demon cornuti con gran ferze,
blocks.translation: Beheld I horned demons with great scourges,

blocks.source: che li battien crudelmente di retro.
blocks.translation: Who cruelly were beating them behind.

blocks.source: Ahi come facean lor levar le berze
blocks.translation: Ah me! how they did make them lift their legs

blocks.source: a le prime percosse! già nessuno
blocks.translation: At the first blows! and sooth not any one

blocks.source: le seconde aspettava né le terze.
blocks.translation: The second waited for, nor for the third.

blocks.source: Mentr’ io andava, li occhi miei in uno
blocks.translation: While I was going on, mine eyes by one

blocks.source: furo scontrati; e io sì tosto dissi:
blocks.translation: Encountered were; and straight I said: “Already

blocks.source: «Già di veder costui non son digiuno».
blocks.translation: With sight of this one I am not unfed.”

blocks.source: Per ch’ïo a figurarlo i piedi affissi;
blocks.translation: Therefore I stayed my feet to make him out,

blocks.source: e ’l dolce duca meco si ristette,
blocks.translation: And with me the sweet Guide came to a stand,

blocks.source: e assentio ch’alquanto in dietro gissi.
blocks.translation: And to my going somewhat back assented;

blocks.source: E quel frustato celar si credette
blocks.translation: And he, the scourged one, thought to hide himself,

blocks.source: bassando ’l viso; ma poco li valse,
blocks.translation: Lowering his face, but little it availed him;

blocks.source: ch’io dissi: «O tu che l’occhio a terra gette,
blocks.translation: For said I: “Thou that castest down thine eyes,

blocks.source: se le fazion che porti non son false,
blocks.translation: If false are not the features which thou bearest,

blocks.source: Venedico se’ tu Caccianemico.
blocks.translation: Thou art Venedico Caccianimico;

blocks.source: Ma che ti mena a sì pungenti salse?».
blocks.translation: But what doth bring thee to such pungent sauces?”

blocks.source: Ed elli a me: «Mal volontier lo dico;
blocks.translation: And he to me: “Unwillingly I tell it;

blocks.source: ma sforzami la tua chiara favella,
blocks.translation: But forces me thine utterance distinct,

blocks.source: che mi fa sovvenir del mondo antico.
blocks.translation: Which makes me recollect the ancient world.

blocks.source: I’ fui colui che la Ghisolabella
blocks.translation: I was the one who the fair Ghisola

blocks.source: condussi a far la voglia del marchese,
blocks.translation: Induced to grant the wishes of the Marquis,

blocks.source: come che suoni la sconcia novella.
blocks.translation: Howe’er the shameless story may be told.

blocks.source: E non pur io qui piango bolognese;
blocks.translation: Not the sole Bolognese am I who weeps here;

blocks.source: anzi n’è questo loco tanto pieno,
blocks.translation: Nay, rather is this place so full of them,

blocks.source: che tante lingue non son ora apprese
blocks.translation: That not so many tongues to-day are taught

blocks.source: a dicer ‘sipa’ tra Sàvena e Reno;
blocks.translation: ’Twixt Reno and Savena to say ‘sipa;’

blocks.source: e se di ciò vuoi fede o testimonio,
blocks.translation: And if thereof thou wishest pledge or proof,

blocks.source: rècati a mente il nostro avaro seno».
blocks.translation: Bring to thy mind our avaricious heart.”

blocks.source: Così parlando il percosse un demonio
blocks.translation: While speaking in this manner, with his scourge

blocks.source: de la sua scurïada, e disse: «Via,
blocks.translation: A demon smote him, and said: “Get thee gone

blocks.source: ruffian! qui non son femmine da conio».
blocks.translation: Pander, there are no women here for coin.”

blocks.source: I’ mi raggiunsi con la scorta mia;
blocks.translation: I joined myself again unto mine Escort;

blocks.source: poscia con pochi passi divenimmo
blocks.translation: Thereafterward with footsteps few we came

blocks.source: là ’v’ uno scoglio de la ripa uscia.
blocks.translation: To where a crag projected from the bank.

blocks.source: Assai leggeramente quel salimmo;
blocks.translation: This very easily did we ascend,

blocks.source: e vòlti a destra su per la sua scheggia,
blocks.translation: And turning to the right along its ridge,

blocks.source: da quelle cerchie etterne ci partimmo.
blocks.translation: From those eternal circles we departed.

blocks.source: Quando noi fummo là dov’ el vaneggia
blocks.translation: When we were there, where it is hollowed out

blocks.source: di sotto per dar passo a li sferzati,
blocks.translation: Beneath, to give a passage to the scourged,

blocks.source: lo duca disse: «Attienti, e fa che feggia
blocks.translation: The Guide said: “Wait, and see that on thee strike

blocks.source: lo viso in te di quest’ altri mal nati,
blocks.translation: The vision of those others evil-born,

blocks.source: ai quali ancor non vedesti la faccia
blocks.translation: Of whom thou hast not yet beheld the faces,

blocks.source: però che son con noi insieme andati».
blocks.translation: Because together with us they have gone.”

blocks.source: Del vecchio ponte guardavam la traccia
blocks.translation: From the old bridge we looked upon the train

blocks.source: che venìa verso noi da l’altra banda,
blocks.translation: Which tow’rds us came upon the other border,

blocks.source: e che la ferza similmente scaccia.
blocks.translation: And which the scourges in like manner smite.

blocks.source: E ’l buon maestro, sanza mia dimanda,
blocks.translation: And the good Master, without my inquiring,

blocks.source: mi disse: «Guarda quel grande che vene,
blocks.translation: Said to me: “See that tall one who is coming,

blocks.source: e per dolor non par lagrime spanda:
blocks.translation: And for his pain seems not to shed a tear;

blocks.source: quanto aspetto reale ancor ritene!
blocks.translation: Still what a royal aspect he retains!

blocks.source: Quelli è Iasón, che per cuore e per senno
blocks.translation: That Jason is, who by his heart and cunning

blocks.source: li Colchi del monton privati féne.
blocks.translation: The Colchians of the Ram made destitute.

blocks.source: Ello passò per l’isola di Lenno
blocks.translation: He by the isle of Lemnos passed along

blocks.source: poi che l’ardite femmine spietate
blocks.translation: After the daring women pitiless

blocks.source: tutti li maschi loro a morte dienno.
blocks.translation: Had unto death devoted all their males.

blocks.source: Ivi con segni e con parole ornate
blocks.translation: There with his tokens and with ornate words

blocks.source: Isifile ingannò, la giovinetta
blocks.translation: Did he deceive Hypsipyle, the maiden

blocks.source: che prima avea tutte l’altre ingannate.
blocks.translation: Who first, herself, had all the rest deceived.

blocks.source: Lasciolla quivi, gravida, soletta;
blocks.translation: There did he leave her pregnant and forlorn;

blocks.source: tal colpa a tal martiro lui condanna;
blocks.translation: Such sin unto such punishment condemns him,

blocks.source: e anche di Medea si fa vendetta.
blocks.translation: And also for Medea is vengeance done.

blocks.source: Con lui sen va chi da tal parte inganna;
blocks.translation: With him go those who in such wise deceive;

blocks.source: e questo basti de la prima valle
blocks.translation: And this sufficient be of the first valley

blocks.source: sapere e di color che ’n sé assanna».
blocks.translation: To know, and those that in its jaws it holds.”

blocks.source: Già eravam là ’ve lo stretto calle
blocks.translation: We were already where the narrow path

blocks.source: con l’argine secondo s’incrocicchia,
blocks.translation: Crosses athwart the second dike, and forms

blocks.source: e fa di quello ad un altr’ arco spalle.
blocks.translation: Of that a buttress for another arch.

blocks.source: Quindi sentimmo gente che si nicchia
blocks.translation: Thence we heard people, who are making moan

blocks.source: ne l’altra bolgia e che col muso scuffa,
blocks.translation: In the next Bolgia, snorting with their muzzles,

blocks.source: e sé medesma con le palme picchia.
blocks.translation: And with their palms beating upon themselves

blocks.source: Le ripe eran grommate d’una muffa,
blocks.translation: The margins were incrusted with a mould

blocks.source: per l’alito di giù che vi s’appasta,
blocks.translation: By exhalation from below, that sticks there,

blocks.source: che con li occhi e col naso facea zuffa.
blocks.translation: And with the eyes and nostrils wages war.

blocks.source: Lo fondo è cupo sì, che non ci basta
blocks.translation: The bottom is so deep, no place suffices

blocks.source: loco a veder sanza montare al dosso
blocks.translation: To give us sight of it, without ascending

blocks.source: de l’arco, ove lo scoglio più sovrasta.
blocks.translation: The arch’s back, where most the crag impends.

blocks.source: Quivi venimmo; e quindi giù nel fosso
blocks.translation: Thither we came, and thence down in the moat

blocks.source: vidi gente attuffata in uno sterco
blocks.translation: I saw a people smothered in a filth

blocks.source: che da li uman privadi parea mosso.
blocks.translation: That out of human privies seemed to flow;

blocks.source: E mentre ch’io là giù con l’occhio cerco,
blocks.translation: And whilst below there with mine eye I search,

blocks.source: vidi un col capo sì di merda lordo,
blocks.translation: I saw one with his head so foul with ordure,

blocks.source: che non parëa s’era laico o cherco.
blocks.translation: It was not clear if he were clerk or layman.

blocks.source: Quei mi sgridò: «Perché se’ tu sì gordo
blocks.translation: He screamed to me: “Wherefore art thou so eager

blocks.source: di riguardar più me che li altri brutti?».
blocks.translation: To look at me more than the other foul ones?”

blocks.source: E io a lui: «Perché, se ben ricordo,
blocks.translation: And I to him: “Because, if I remember,

blocks.source: già t’ho veduto coi capelli asciutti,
blocks.translation: I have already seen thee with dry hair,

blocks.source: e se’ Alessio Interminei da Lucca:
blocks.translation: And thou’rt Alessio Interminei of Lucca;

blocks.source: però t’adocchio più che li altri tutti».
blocks.translation: Therefore I eye thee more than all the others.”

blocks.source: Ed elli allor, battendosi la zucca:
blocks.translation: And he thereon, belabouring his pumpkin:

blocks.source: «Qua giù m’hanno sommerso le lusinghe
blocks.translation: “The flatteries have submerged me here below,

blocks.source: ond’ io non ebbi mai la lingua stucca».
blocks.translation: Wherewith my tongue was never surfeited.”

blocks.source: Appresso ciò lo duca «Fa che pinghe»,
blocks.translation: Then said to me the Guide: “See that thou thrust

blocks.source: mi disse, «il viso un poco più avante,
blocks.translation: Thy visage somewhat farther in advance,

blocks.source: sì che la faccia ben con l’occhio attinghe
blocks.translation: That with thine eyes thou well the face attain

blocks.source: di quella sozza e scapigliata fante
blocks.translation: Of that uncleanly and dishevelled drab,

blocks.source: che là si graffia con l’unghie merdose,
blocks.translation: Who there doth scratch herself with filthy nails,

blocks.source: e or s’accoscia e ora è in piedi stante.
blocks.translation: And crouches now, and now on foot is standing.

blocks.source: Taïde è, la puttana che rispuose
blocks.translation: Thais the harlot is it, who replied

blocks.source: al drudo suo quando disse “Ho io grazie
blocks.translation: Unto her paramour, when he said, ‘Have I

blocks.source: grandi apo te?”: “Anzi maravigliose!”.
blocks.translation: Great gratitude from thee?’—‘Nay, marvellous;’

blocks.source: E quinci sian le nostre viste sazie».
blocks.translation: And herewith let our sight be satisfied.”
